title: E-Bike Battery Winter Cover 2-Pack – Black with Orange Interior
seo_description: 2 battery covers for an e-bike frame battery. Black outside, orange inside, hook-and-loop strap keeps the cover in place without tools.
descriptionHtml:
The battery loses range as soon as the cold sets in

Lithium batteries feel the cold, and the e-bike ends up standing outside or in an unheated shed all winter with the battery fully exposed on the frame. On the first morning ride you're met by a battery that's already cold before you've even pedaled off.

A layer around the battery, fastened with a hook-and-loop strap

The cover wraps around the battery on the frame's down tube, black outside and orange inside, and closes with a wide hook-and-loop strap, no tools needed. Two covers in the pack — one for each bike, or a spare to swap in when you wash one.

Features

  • 2 covers in the pack – one for each bike, or a spare to swap in
  • Wraps around the battery on the frame's down tube – where most e-bike batteries are mounted
  • The hook-and-loop strap holds the cover in place – on and off without tools
  • A layer between the battery and the cold – helps the battery cells hold their heat
  • Measure your battery before you buy – the cover is 54 × 45.7 cm unfolded and fits a frame or battery with a 30–40 cm circumference (supplier's measurements)

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

Our Guarantee

14 days to change your mind – if you don't like it, you get your money back. Tracked delivery and secure checkout. 🦫
